title: Finite element theta schemes for the viscous Burgers' equation with nonlinear Neumann boundary feedback control
summary: In this article, we develop a fully discrete numerical scheme for the one-dimensional (1D) and two-dimensional (2D) viscous Burgers equations with nonlinear Neumann boundary feedback control. The temporal discretization employs a $θ$-scheme, while a conforming finite element method is used for the spatial approximation. The existence and uniqueness of the fully discrete solution are established.
